regions.why: "Research on: more ideas on screen, “Kria hit a problem”" is "Fixed or new with PR fix", and its two region states would show "Works on the PR branch"

classes.end: Research on: no ideas yet, “Kria hit a problem”
classes.rule: "When the AI came up with an idea that passes the checks, I never see 'Kria hit a problem'."
classes.cause: with Research on, the fact checker rejects the whole batch when it flags one idea, so good ideas are thrown away and the request fails
classes.fix: Research on: Find ideas, dropping repeats

classes.end: Research off: no ideas yet, “No idea found yet”
classes.rule: "'No idea found yet' means the AI actually looked this time, not a replay."
classes.cause: an empty first answer is saved, so tapping Find ideas again with the same direction replays it without asking the AI
classes.fix: Research off: Find ideas, checking saved answers
